Non Profit Description

Education for Global Peace (EGP) is an organization dedicated to building a global network and movement that promotes cultures of peace. Our mission is to foster a global transformation whereby peace education empowers children, youth, and adults in a variety of educational settings, so that they possess the knowledge, skills and attitudes to build peace in the world around them.


Role Description

This is a remote volunteer role for a Board Member. As a Board Member, you will contribute to the strategic direction and decision-making process of EGP. Your tasks include attending board meetings, reviewing organizational policies, and providing guidance and support.

We are especially interested in those with skills or experience in fundraising and those with skills or experience in communications.

EGP greatly appreciates the time and commitment of our board. Board member positions are an opportunity to make a real and meaningful difference in our world. 


Qualifications
Experience in leadership roles or serving on a boardKnowledge and/or passion for promoting peace education and global peaceExcellent communication and interpersonal skillsAbility to work remotely and collaboratively with a diverse teamStrategic thinking and problem solving abilitiesBackground in education, peace studies, international relations or related field is beneficial but not necessary
